{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|servings=8–12|time=1 hour 30 minutes|difficulty=4| Image = [[Image:Millionaire's shortbread.jpg|250px]]}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Desserts]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United Kingdom|Cuisine of the United Kingdom]]

'''Caramel squares''' (alternatively: '''caramel slices''', '''caramel shortbread''', or '''millionaire's shortbread''') are a wonderfully rich and classic treat, very popular all over [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United Kingdom|Britain]] and [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Ireland|Ireland]]. They can often be found in cafes, served with morning coffee or afternoon tea. They're perfect for [[cookbook:picnic|picnic]]s, lunches and your guests will love them! They have a crunchy base with a creamy caramel filling, topped off with chocolate.

== Ingredients ==

=== Base ===
*350 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Self-rising Flour|self-raising flour]]
*225 g unsalted [[cookbook:butter|butter]]
*110 g [[cookbook:caster sugar|caster sugar]]

=== Filling ===
*225 g [[cookbook:Caster sugar|caster sugar]]
*225 g unsalted [[cookbook:butter|butter]]
*5 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tablespoons]] [[cookbook:Golden Syrup|golden syrup]]
*400 [[Cookbook:ML|ml]] full-fat [[cookbook:condensed milk|condensed milk]]

=== Topping ===
*340 g good-quality [[cookbook:chocolate|chocolate]] (milk or dark), melted

==Procedure==

=== Base ===
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 180°C (gas mark 4; 350°F). Rub flour, butter, and caster sugar together until it resembles breadcrumbs.
#Press into a 25 x 38 x 4 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] Swiss roll pan.
#[[cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 20 minutes or till golden.
#Cool.

=== Filling ===
#Melt butter in a heavy-based [[cookbook:saucepan|saucepan]] over a low heat; add sugar, golden syrup, and condensed milk.
#Stir continuously for 40–50 minutes. It should be golden brown in colour when ready to eat. To test, drop a little blob into a bowl of cold water; it should firm up.
#Pour this caramel mixture over the base, and let it cool.

=== Topping ===
#Pour melted chocolate over the top.
#Spread the chocolate evenly, and let set.

Press into a 25 x 38 x 4 cm Swiss roll pan.
Bake for 20 minutes or till golden.
Melt butter in a heavy-based saucepan over a low heat; add sugar, golden syrup, and condensed milk.
